Ore Metal texture upload: Metal forbids replaceRegion on MTLStorageModePrivate textures (render targets are private), and Metal API Validation aborts on it. Stage the bytes in a shared MTLBuffer and blit them into the requested mip, slice and region on the context queue, then wait, keeping replaceRegion's synchronous semantics. Shared and managed textures keep replaceRegion. The staging buffer covers only the bytes replaceRegion would read, since GpuTexture::upload does not pass dataSize. Combined depth-stencil formats (a plain buffer copy cannot fill them) and block-compressed formats are refused, and a failed staging allocation, command buffer creation or blit is reported, all through setLastError, which GpuTexture::upload turns into false.
